tool_args.rationale: The target horizon is 23, while observations stop at 0.48. The slow-horizon probe directly resolves the resulting long-horizon identifiability ambiguity and can also discriminate the proposed adaptation mechanisms.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit dual-horizon adaptation from the pilot alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon rows do not reliably identify the slow component or its long-horizon reversal.
Further short-horizon detail would be less discriminating for the target horizon.
The pilot does not distinguish it reliably from adaptation at long horizons.
